items.name: MajestyPoemFold/ghostclick-mouse-double-click-fix
items.full_text: Free mouse double click test and fix for Windows 11/10. Finds ghost clicks (mouse chatter, switch bounce) on a strip chart, learns a debounce threshold from your real double-clicks, filters them system-wide from the tray, catches drag and drop drops, and exports RMA evidence. Open source, no ads.
